## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 81 (titled *Dubbala*, "Criticizing a robe distribution") belongs to the *Pācittiya* section of the Theravāda Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga. The rule addresses monks who call into question communal decisions regarding robes: if a monk who is part of a complete, formally assembled Order (*saṅgha*) gives away a robe to an appointed official of the Order, but subsequently criticizes or objects to that transaction, he incurs an offense requiring confession (*pācittiya*). A modern English translation of the text has been made by Bhikkhu Brahmali. Secondary literature search hits for this rule in fact discuss the separate rules of the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha rather than the monk's Vibhaṅga text.
